result.title: Reading Fine-Tuning Diffs Through Lenses: Model Diffing for Backdoor Detection
result.comment: 31 pages, 16 figures, 14 tables. Code and data available at https://github.com/maxipetro/lens-diffing-backdoors
result.summary: We introduce a common scoring system based on token readouts to evaluate weight, activation and output-based model diffing methods for backdoor detection in fine-tuning processes. We also improve existing weight and activation based methods by incorporating the $J$-lens and its refinement, the $J{+}{+}$-lens. We test our setup in experiments where we compare a backdoored model with the base model from which it was fine-tuned. Our results show that incorporating the $J{+}{+}$-lens improves the weight-based method in all our settings, while the $J$-lens improves its ranks within single layers. The strongest single method is $ΔW J{+}{+}$, the weight difference decoded through the $J{+}{+}$-lens of the base model, which ranks a token naming the backdoor among its first ten tokens in 11 of our 12 settings. Moreover, we show that output and activation based methods such as ADL and Diff Mining can easily break if the backdoored model is penalised during fine-tuning for giving the backdoor's words probability on clean inputs, whereas the weight-based methods are not affected. Conversely, permuting the hidden units or training only the layers that read the residual stream hides the backdoor from the weight-based methods but not from ADL and Diff Mining. No single method resists both attacks.

AI.brief_summary: 该论文建立基于 token readout 的统一评分体系，比较权重、激活与输出三类 model diffing 方法在微调后门检测中的表现，并用 J-lens 及 J++-lens 改进权重与激活方法；实验中 ΔW J++ 最强，但无单一方法能同时抵御两类攻击。
AI.relevance_reason: 其把权重差与激活经 lens 解码回词表空间来定位隐藏行为的做法，可能为核查 VLM 内部 latent 状态是否真正承载视觉证据、以及是否存在视觉旁路提供读出与对比工具，但能否迁移到多模态检查点尚待核查。
